title: A PETase enzyme synthesised in the chloroplast of the microalga Chlamydomonas reinhardtii is active against post-consumer plastics
locator: Results: Purification of recombinant PETase; The recombinant PETase is active; Figures 3–5; Discussion
authored_paraphrase: The study reports PETase produced by Chlamydomonas reinhardtii TN72-derived lines. Extracted enzyme preparations changed plastic surfaces; PET and post-consumer material gave different chemical endpoints. Post-consumer material released BHET without a significant TPA signal in the reported assay. The preparation contained another protein. These assays do not establish living algae growing on plastic.

title: Synergistic saccharification, and direct fermentation to ethanol, of amorphous cellulose by use of an engineered yeast strain codisplaying three types of cellulolytic enzyme
locator: PubMed abstract, paragraphs describing enzyme codisplay and ethanol endpoint
authored_paraphrase: The abstract identifies three cellulolytic enzymes from Trichoderma reesei and Aspergillus aculeatus displayed on Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The three-enzyme system converted amorphous cellulose to ethanol; the comparator missing cellobiohydrolase II did not perform that direct conversion. The result supports this joint system and substrate, not untreated wood processing.
